sloka: हन्याम् अहम् इमौ पापौ शत्रु पक्ष प्रशम्सकौ ।यदि पूर्व उपकारैर् मे न क्रोधो मृदुताम् व्रजेत् ॥६-२९-१३॥।।
transliteration: hanyām aham imau pāpau śatru pakṣa praśamsakau ।yadi pūrva upakārair me na krodho mṛdutām vrajet ॥6-29-13॥।।

translations.english: "I would have slayed these two sinners who praise the enemy side, if my anger had not softened and remembered their earlier services."
